entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10346"/><div sID="gen18466" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10346"/><hi type="bold">16. Jerusalem--</hi>In <reference osisRef="Jer.23.6">Jr 23:6</reference>, instead of this, it is "Israel." "The name" in the Hebrew has here to be supplied from that passage; and for "he" (Messiah, the antitypical "Israel"), the antecedent there (<reference osisRef="Isa.49.3">Is 49:3</reference>), we have "she" here, that is, Jerusalem. She is called by the same name as Messiah, "The Lord Our Righteousness," by virtue of the mystical oneness between her (as the literal representative of the spiritual Church) and her Lord and Husband. Thus, whatever belongs to the Head belongs also to the members (<reference osisRef="Eph.5.30">Ep 5:30</reference>, <reference osisRef="Eph.5.32">32</reference>). Hence, the Church is called "Christ" (<reference osisRef="Rom.16.7">Ro 16:7</reference>; <reference osisRef="1Cor.12.12">1Co 12:12</reference>). The Church hereby professes to draw all her righteousness from Christ (<reference osisRef="Isa.45.24">Is 45:24</reference>, <reference osisRef="Isa.45.25">25</reference>). It is for the sake of Jerusalem, literal and spiritual, that God the Father gives this name (Jehovah, Tsidkenu, "The Lord our Righteousness") to Christ. <div eID="gen18466" type="x-p"/>

entries.reader_content_plain: 18. Messiah's literal priesthood ( He 7:17 , 21, 24-28), and His followers' spiritual priesthood and sacrifices ( Jr 33:11 ; Ro 12:1 ; 15:16 ; 1Pe 2:5 , 9 ; Re 1:6 ), shall never cease, according to the covenant with Levi, broken by the priests, but fulfilled by Messiah ( Nu 25:12 , 13 ; Mal 2:4, 5 , 8 ).

(<reference osisRef="Gen.15.5">Ge 15:5</reference>; <reference osisRef="Gen.22.17">22:17</reference>). The blessing there promised belonged to all the tribes; here it is restricted to the family of David and the tribe of Levi, because it was on these that the welfare of the whole people rested. When the kingdom and priesthood flourish in the person of Messiah, the whole nation shall temporally and spiritually prosper. <div eID="gen18470" type="x-p"/>
